import logging
from typing import List, Optional

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends

from api.dependencies.database import get_db
from core.models import Project
from core.repositories.project import ProjectRepository
from core.schemas import ProjectListSchema
from core.services.projects import ProjectsService

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

router = APIRouter()


@router.get("/", response_model=ProjectListSchema)
async def list_projects(
    projects_service: ProjectsService = Depends(ProjectsService),
    db: ProjectRepository = Depends(get_db),
) -> List[Project]:
    """Get a list of all projects."""
    return await projects_service.list_all_projects(db)


@router.post("/")
async def create_project(
    project: Project,
    projects_service: ProjectsService = Depends(ProjectsService),
    db: ProjectRepository = Depends(get_db),
) -> Project:
    """Create a new project."""
    return await projects_service.create_project(project, db)


@router.put("/{id}")
async def update_project(
    id: int,
    project: Project,
    projects_service: ProjectsService = Depends(ProjectsService),
    db: ProjectRepository = Depends(get_db),
) -> Optional[Project]:
    """Update an existing project."""
    return await projects_service.update_project(id, project, db)


@router.delete("/{id}")
async def delete_project(
    id: int,
    projects_service: ProjectsService = Depends(ProjectsService),
    db: ProjectRepository = Depends(get_db),
) -> bool:
    """Delete an existing project."""
    return await projects_service.delete_project(id, db)
